cover_headline: Comment Window Closes on Plan to End Deference for H-1B Extensions
facts: The public comment period on the proposal to end deference for work-visa extensions closed on November 13, 2026
DHS estimates about 208,429 extension petitions a year would lose deference, and about 6,044 more requests for evidence a year would follow
Workers born in India were 77.6% of H-1B approvals for continuing employment, according to USCIS's FY 2025 report to Congress

end.headline: Comment Window Closes on Plan to End Deference for H-1B Extensions
end.line: DHS proposes deleting the one regulation that tells USCIS to respect a prior approval when an extension changes nothing.
